mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(t.request_snapshot),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(t.goal),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(t.summary),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(t.model_snapshot),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(t.tools_snapshot),0)+(SELECT OCTET_LENGTH(binding_snapshot)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(retained_digests),0) FROM task_todo_projection WHERE tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND task_id=t.id)+(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(request_snapshot)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(response_snapshot),0)),0) FROM step WHERE tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND task_id=t.id)+(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(input_snapshot)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(output_snapshot),0)),0) FROM invocation WHERE tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND task_id=t.id)+(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(usage_snapshot),0)),0) FROM model_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND task_id=t.id) FROM task t WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task}
